# nomatron_environment (Resource)

Nomatron application environment resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_environment" "example" {
  org_name   = "platform"
  app_slug   = "payments"
  job_slug   = "web"
  name       = "Production"
  slug       = "prod"
  cluster_id = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
  namespace  = "payments-prod"
  priority   = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the environment.
- `cluster_id` (String) Nomad cluster ID used by the environment.
- `job_slug` (String) Job slug that owns the environment.
- `name` (String) Environment display name.
- `namespace` (String) Nomad namespace for the environment.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.
- `priority` (Number) Relative environment priority used by Nomatron.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable environment slug. If omitted, the server generates one.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the environment was created.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the environment was last updated.
